title: **File associations are cached by type for the page.** Files sharing a final name extension share one answer; extensions that differ only in case, such as `.PNG` and `.png`, are separate types. A per-document override, such as a macOS “Open...

attrs.text: **File associations are cached by type for the page.** Files sharing a final name extension share one answer; extensions that differ only in case, such as `.PNG` and `.png`, are separate types. A per-document override, such as a macOS “Open with” choice for one file, can therefore show the type’s previous answer until the background query corrects the open menu. Linux content sniffing and multi-part extensions such as `.tar.gz` have the same effect, and one file’s empty answer shows the row disabled for the type’s other files the same way. Choosing the row before the correction opens the application that answer named. Names without an extension are recorded per path. Records, with one icon per application, grow with the file types seen and end with the page.

Persistent reminders require the separately tracked follow-up; this package writes no read-state files.
